title: The document's Summary shows Shop supplies under Parts cost
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Summary reads "Parts cost $80.00" and under it "Shop supplies $15.00".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S10-R3: “The Close confirmation (S3-R2) shows the row "Shop supplies $[amount]" with the note "Posted to [work order's expense account], credited to [shop supplies account]"; the shop supplies account is the income account of the existing "Shop supplies" item (Products And Services) in QuickBooks or the Shop supplies expense row in AccountingHub; the NO CHARGE document shows "Shop supplies $[amount]" in the Summary under Parts cost; the Internal Work Orders report shows it as a column (S9-R2).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
